notes.title: Nogalious (Steam) by JIM SMALE @ GERT LUSH GAMING
notes.content:
http://www.gertlushgaming.co.uk/2018/08/10/review-nogalious-steam/

Nogalious is a retro-style action platformer that pays homage to the era of classic 2D platforming on 8-bit personal computers. Explore 5 different worlds and go through cozy dungeons in the first title of a trilogy that tells the story of Nogalious, his daughter Mariet, and the evil Darama.

Pros:

- 8-Bit graphics.
- 87MB Download size.
- Steam achievements.
- Opening optional tutorial.
- Classic chiptune soundtrack.
- 2D platformer gameplay.
- A wide variety of weapons like boomerangs, bombs, swords and more.
- Difficult.
- Clear UI.
- Online and offline leaderboards.
- Arcade feels.
- Three continues.
- Tight handling/controls.
- A lot of fun.
- Boss fights.

Cons:

- Broken English and spelling mistakes in dialogue.
- Tutorial not that helpful.
- Difficult.
- The learning curve with the way weapons work and controls respond.

The Numbers:

- Graphics - 8/10
- Sound - 7/10
- Accessability - 7/10
- Length - 7/10
- Fun Factor - 8/10

Total: 7.4 / 10

Summary

A great nostalgia trip, A game likes this really hits you in the childhood and runs with it. A solid 2D platformer full of difficult boss battles and clever level design. I could easily see this on my TV back in the day and it made me smile, Well in between all the swearing as like I say it is a bit difficult in places. InIts a short review as its a very clear-cut game, Its retro looking, Plays like a retro game and is worth your time.
